  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:

  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np, math
rw=Chem.RWMol()
# atom symbols heavy atoms in mapped order
syms=['C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','C','O','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','O','C','C','c','c','c','c','c','c','C','C','O','O','C']
for s in syms: rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(s))
# add bonds helper
S=Chem.BondType.SINGLE; D=Chem.BondType.DOUBLE
edges=[(0,1,S),(1,2,S),(2,3,S),(3,4,S),(4,5,S),(5,0,S),
(0,6,S),(5,10,S),(10,9,S),(9,6,S),(6,8,S),(8,7,S),(7,6,S),
(9,11,S),(11,12,S),(12,13,S),(13,14,S),(14,15,S),(15,9,S),
(12,16,S),(16,17,S),(17,18,D),(17,19,S),(19,20,D),(20,21,S),
(21,22,S),(22,23,S),(23,24,S),(24,25,S),(25,26,S),(26,21,S),
(13,27,S),(3,28,S),(28,29,D),(28,30,S),(30,31,S)]
for i,j,b in edges: rw.AddBond(i,j,b)
m=rw.GetMol()
# aromaticize phenyl
for i in range(21,27): m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True)
for i,j in [(21,22),(22,23),(23,24),(24,25),(25,26),(26,21)]:
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j); b.SetBondType(Chem.BondType.AROMATIC); b.SetIsAromatic(True)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# set alkene stereo E, actual atom indices
b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(19,20)
b.SetStereoAtoms(17,21)
b.SetStereo(Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE)
# coordinates from image, y inverted, scale about 105px/A
pix={0:(575,304),1:(471,244),2:(367,304),3:(367,427),4:(471,489),5:(575,428),6:(690,270),7:(790,183),8:(666,155),9:(765,370),10:(685,455),11:(840,260),12:(944,260),13:(1004,369),14:(944,475),15:(840,475),16:(1004,159),17:(1120,157),18:(1184,54),19:(1182,260),20:(1303,260),21:(1365,369),22:(1484,369),23:(1547,477),24:(1484,584),25:(1365,584),26:(1303,477),27:(1120,369),28:(280,476),29:(330,540),30:(235,455),31:(170,455)}
# Establish coordinates in Å; image y -> + upward
coords={i:np.array([pix[i][0]/105.,-pix[i][1]/105.,0.]) for i in pix}
# Set z offset for wedge bond endpoints (toward viewer positive)
# helper assigns offset relative plane at atom center
# H shown wedge at 0,5; ester substituent at D; epoxide links at 6; Q to T1 and O15; T2 to O16; R to methyl
wedges=[(0,None,1),(5,None,1),(3,28,1),(6,7,1),(6,8,-1),(9,11,-1),(9,15,1),(12,16,-1),(13,27,-1)]
# For heavy endpoint z positions based wedges
for center,other,sign in wedges:
 if other is not None: coords[other][2]=sign*0.55
# Create conformer heavy atoms
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()):
 p=coords[i]; conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(*map(float,p)))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# Add explicit H and coordinates
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
conf=m.GetConformer()
# Hydrogens generated via AddHs; choose explicit wedge Hs 0 and 5 and set spatially according to shown direction
for center, xyvec in [(0,(0,1)),(5,(0,-1))]:
 atom=m.GetAtomWithIdx(center)
 hidx=next(n.GetIdx() for n in atom.GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1)
 cp=np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(center))
 v=np.array([xyvec[0],xyvec[1],1.0]); v=v/np.linalg.norm(v)*1.0
 conf.SetAtomPosition(hidx,Point3D(*(cp+v)))
# generated conformer Hs at other centers could be planar or bad; ensure z offsets for wedge heavy bonds establish stereochemistry
# Assign tetra tags based on the constructed 3D coordinates
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True,flagPossibleStereoCenters=True)
print('Stereo before embed:')
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
print('alkene',m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(19,20).GetStereo())
# Set stereochemistry bond E after Assign stereo may persist
# Embed with stereochem
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=152; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True; params.enforceChirality=True
# remove old conformer to avoid using as initial, preserve stereo tags
m.RemoveAllConformers()
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed status',status)
if status<0: raise RuntimeError('embed failed')
# run MMFF optimize
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props)
 print('energy start',ff.CalcEnergy())
 ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
 print('energy end',ff.CalcEnergy())
else:
 AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
# verify stereochem after embedding
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True,flagPossibleStereoCenters=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print('final stereo',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
print('alkene final',m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(19,20).GetStereo())
# Ensure stereo same expected prior
# output XYZ
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n')
 f.write('3D structure generated from mol_0152.png\n')
 cf=m.GetConformer()
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=cf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('wrote',m.GetNumAtoms())
PY
